title: Successfully Delivered 86" Commercial Display Fully Automated Assembly Line to Mexico
contentHtml:
In February 2026, TXAM successfully delivered a customized 86" commercial display fully automated assembly line to a renowned commercial display manufacturer in Mexico, with 5 containers of complete line equipment shipped cross-border.

Project Overview

The production line covers core processes such as automatic dispensing, high-precision lamination, and automatic screw fastening, perfectly solving the challenge of damage-free assembly for ultra-large flexible screens. This marks another major breakthrough for TXAM in the Americas market, following its success in Southeast Asia.

Technical Highlights

The entire line utilizes TXAM's independently developed high-precision robotic dispensing system (±0.2mm), combined with a UVW vision alignment platform, to achieve high-precision lamination of large-size panels. Through the intelligent control system, the production line enables one-click product switching, compatible with 65~110" multi-size products.

After overseas delivery, the equipment has operated stably and received high praise from the customer, laying a solid foundation for future in-depth cooperation.
